details.report:
R1 — Delete `captureGitState` from `src/recorder/run.ts`, its `execFileSync` dependency if then unused, and its pre-stage-allocation call; remove `git-state` from `RECORDER_STAGES` and `schemas/recorder-failure-v1.schema.json`. Regenerate Recorder dist. Add no replacement probe, logging, fallback, or historical-cause claim.
R2 — In `src/recorder/config.ts`, keep identity checks in pure structure but reject each generated filename both exactly and as a complete prefix (`name/...`), and compare structure-normalized repository/path coordinates (including aliases such as `/repo` versus `/repo/.`) while retaining the later declaration’s typed location and pre-scan phase ordering. In `src/recorder/admit.ts`, restore exactly one set keyed by the verified canonical reference coordinates returned from `verifyGitReference`, rejecting state-dependent aliases before spawn; leave manifest uniqueness as defense only and do not duplicate pure checks in admission. Extend config/admission tests for all generated names, nested prefixes, lexical aliases, symlink/realpath canonical aliases, typed locations, and unchanged child counters.
R3 — Replace every manifest-owned direct `RecorderError("internal-error")` construction in `src/recorder/manifest.ts` with one manifest-stage safe internal-error owner (using `internalRecorderError("manifest", cause)` or an equivalent helper), including schema loading/ref resolution/validation, child/coherence, artifact, and uniqueness invariants. Ensure every such failure has a non-null allow-listed diagnostic while public output remains limited to stage/category and excludes messages, IDs, paths, stacks, config, argv, environment, and secrets. Add direct manifest and reachable Recorder-level duplicate-identity regressions asserting the diagnostic and nonleak behavior.
R4 — Redesign `src/recorder/spawn.ts` so process start confirmation, exact close settlement, and stdout/stderr tee completion are separately represented and tee rejections are handled immediately. Have `src/recorder/run.ts` install an exited/signaled outcome as soon as settlement is available, then convert a failed tee into a Recorder/internal failure with no promotion; preserve `not-spawned` only for genuine pre-start failure and never classify a post-start tee fault as `spawn-failed`. Add real seam tests using a deterministic unwritable/failing filesystem sink (no production test hook) for both normal exit and signal, asserting Recorder 125, exact child truth, and absent promoted docket.
R5 — Export/consume the TypeScript failure code, stage, and diagnostic-category lists in a package/schema test that reads the shipped `schemas/recorder-failure-v1.schema.json` and deep-compares all three enums exactly, thereby covering R1 vocabulary removal and future drift. Reformat `src/recorder/config.ts` and rename opaque locals/helpers (`v`, `i`, `p`, `r`, `k`, `x`, `e`, `n`, and similarly unclear boundary names) descriptively without changing validation order, phase ownership, or typed locations; regenerate dist.
R6 — Consolidate the Judge-required reserved exact/prefix, structural alias, canonical admission, manifest diagnostic/nonleak, and exit/signal tee regressions into the existing owning Recorder suites, avoiding duplicate probes. In apply, verify focused Recorder tests, full `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build:recorder`, package/schema content checks, `npm pack --dry-run`, and `git diff --check`; inspect the final worktree and current-head diff, then create one new forward `fix(recorder): ...` commit without amend and confirm HEAD descends from `bb09008`. The completion evidence will report current-head results only, retain the historical-root non-claim, and keep issue #13 excluded.
